name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/tags-core
description: The tag system's shared logic for Quartz 5 plugins: the resolution rule, the shapes the quartz-tags engine publishes, their fileData types, the tag hierarchy's rules and which pages are private, the tag bubble every badge draws, a colour resolver for canvases, and a build-time check for colour values. See CONTEXT.md.
//exports: Source only: no build and no dist. The consuming plugin's build inlines it (ADR-0005). `./colour` is browser-only; `./colour-value` is server-only, and takes the host's lightningcss from the plugin that calls it. `./bubble` runs anywhere, and `./bubble.css` is the bubble's library CSS, which the consuming plugin ships in its own family layer.
//scripts: lint-css.mjs imports src/bubble.ts for the palette it checks the stylesheet against, so Node strips its types (unflagged only from Node 22.18; the repo's .nvmrc is 22.16).
//devDependencies: Types, and the library-CSS check the lint target runs on the bubble's stylesheet (@chaoticgoodcomputing/css-check). `vfile` is the module the fileData augmentation extends; a consuming plugin resolves its own copy, the host Quartz's. Libraries depend on each other by `workspace:*` (ADR-0005).
